possibleCondition: Acute gastroenteritis or norovirus-related gastrointestinal infection
koreanCondition: 급성 위장염 또는 노로바이러스 관련 장염 가능성
summary: The symptoms may be related to acute gastroenteritis. Visiting a pharmacy is recommended first if there are no red-flag symptoms.
reason: The user reports abdominal cramping and nausea.
The pain score is 7 out of 10.
Norovirus is currently common in Korea during winter.

options.title: Self-care
options.description: Drink water slowly, rest, and avoid spicy or greasy foods.

options.title: Visit a pharmacy
options.description: Consult a pharmacist and show your allergy and medication information.

options.title: Visit a hospital
options.description: Visit a hospital immediately if high fever, blood in stool, severe dehydration, persistent vomiting, or worsening pain occurs.

safetyNotes: Do not take ibuprofen because the user has an ibuprofen allergy.
Consult a pharmacist before taking medicine because the user is currently taking GERD medication.
disclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis. Please consult a pharmacist or doctor if symptoms worsen.
